 Barcelona Climbs UWCL Standings as Champions League Matchday 3 Kicks Off
 Defending Champions League winner Barcelona enters Matchday 3 carrying the UWCL’s only perfect record. (Joan Valls/Urbanandsport/NurPhoto via Getty Images) 
 Oct 28, 2026
 Meredith Heil
 Europe’s best are back in action, as the UWCL kicks off Matchday 3 of six this afternoon with defending champion Barcelona rolling while the 2026/27 Champions League table takes shape.
 Barça (2-2-0) visits HB Køge (1-0-1) as the only team with all six points , tallying 11 League Phase goals behind Caroline Graham Hansen and Ewa Pajor’s UWCL-leading three goals each.
 Two other unbeaten clashes anchor the slate, as Bayern (1-1-0) hosts Real Madrid (0-2-0) and OL Lyonnes (1-1-0) faces Inter Milan (1-1-0). 
 Big-name rematches , breakout players, and key absences shape the rest of the two-day lineup.
 2025/26 winner Arsenal (1-1-0) hosts Benfica (1-0-1) without Mariona Caldentey and Selina Cerci, while Chelsea (1-1-0) looks to run back last year’s win over Roma (0-1-1).
 WSL champion Man City (0-2-0) takes on PSG (1-1-0), after the French side pulled off a  5-0 rout of OH Leuven behind Naomie Feller’s two goals and two assists.
 UWCL Matchday 3 kicks off today at 1:45 PM ET ( Paramount+ ).
